# search { #crossrepo.search }

```python
crossrepo.search(
    query,
    repo=None,
    pattern=None,
    *,
    refresh=False,
    progress=True,
    cfg=None,
)
```

Search what the configured repositories publish, best match first.

The python side of ``crossrepo search``, and a listing like
[](`crossrepo.list`) in every respect but two: only the files the query
matches are in it, and they come best match first. The query is matched
fuzzily against each file's repository, path and description, so it may
be a few words, a misspelling or an abbreviation, as
[](`crossrepo.core.rank`) describes.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**query**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Words to look for, such as ``"gwas hits"``. Every word must match.

<code>[**repo**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Keep only repositories whose ``owner/repo`` contains this, as in [](`crossrepo.list`).

<code>[**pattern**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Keep only files whose name matches this glob, such as ``"*.csv"``.

<code>[**refresh**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [False]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Rescan before searching, rather than using the stored catalog.

<code>[**progress**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [True]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Show a progress bar while rescanning, as [](`crossrepo.list`) does.

<code>[**cfg**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Settings. Defaults to [](`crossrepo.config.active_config`).

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A `Table` with the columns `LIST_COLUMNS` names, as [](`crossrepo.list`) returns, holding the matching files best match first. Empty, but with its columns, when nothing matches.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ValueError](`ValueError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If `query` holds no words.

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ImportError](`ImportError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If pandas is not installed. It is not a dependency of `crossrepo`.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
import crossrepo

crossrepo.search("gwas hits")               # several words, all must match
crossrepo.search("bordrs")                  # a typo is forgiven
crossrepo.search("effect", pattern="*.parquet")
```
